reuse.why: Every change goes through the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the tolerance reuses getApproxNumberThreshold, and the budget template's private midpoint formula is replaced by the shared helper.

duplication.why: The expected-amount rule exists in exactly one function; the template's inline copy of the old range rule is removed.

placement.why: Rule in shared/schedules.ts, API field in scheduleModel.toExternal with a typed list-item type in api-handlers, call sites only pass their value and operator.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and its callers; the only wart is a step-1 release note still describing 'furthest from zero', which the final rule replaced.

maintainability.why: A single helper whose op parameter names the real variation, threaded consistently through server, API and client call sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All expected-amount computations, including schedule-template.ts which previously computed its own midpoint, call getScheduledAmount.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter (default 'is') and one isapprox branch; every server, API and client display/balance call site passes the operator.
